source_row.rationale: Normal ejection fraction is generally considered to be approximately 50-70%. A value of 30% is significantly reduced, consistent with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), reflecting impaired systolic pumping function of the heart.
source_row.source_detail: EF classification: under 40% usually indicates heart failure/cardiomyopathy and HFrEF; last reviewed 2025-05-30; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: American Heart Association — Ejection Fraction Heart Failure Measurement
